name: Lens imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes, one of the Magma King's: leathery skin, short curled horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, red-tinted, carrying a jagged shard of red-hot glass

poses.stand: hovering mid-air on spread bat wings, holding out in both hands a jagged shard of red glass like a lantern, glowing a hot red-white, a thin red beam line starting from it
poses.struck: just hit and caught mid-shriek: eyes bulging, mouth stretched open, wings snapped up, body tilted back with cracks of orange light glowing through its skin
poses.dead: bursting apart in a small round pop of black soot and bright orange embers, only its horns tumbling out of the puff

idle.action: hovers, flapping, the shard glowing and pulsing in its hands

attack.action: raises the shard overhead and swings it slowly down to the right, the glass blazing, then hovers again

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a yelp, wings crumpling, then recovers

die.action: shrieks, swells with orange light shining through the cracks in its skin, and pops like a firecracker into a puff of black soot and embers
